points.title: 早年生活与创业
points.description: 雷·克洛克在1920年代初期出生于芝加哥，他的早年生活充满了挑战。他在当地的一家药房工作，开始了他的职业生涯。在20世纪30年代，他成为一家牛奶搅拌机的销售代表，这为他后来的商业成功奠定了基础。他的销售技巧和商业洞察力在这一时期得到了锻炼。
points.descriptionEn: Ray Kroc was born in Chicago in the early 1920s, and his early life was filled with challenges. He worked at a local pharmacy, starting his career. In the 1930s, he became a sales representative for a milkshake mixer, which laid the foundation for his later business success. His sales skills and business acumen were honed during this period.

points.place: 加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺
points.title: 麦当劳的发现与扩张
points.description: 1950年，克洛克在加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺发现了第一家麦当劳餐厅。他看到了其独特的商业模式和潜在的巨大商机，于是决定投资并帮助麦当劳进行全国扩张。这一决策最终导致了麦当劳成为全球最大的快餐连锁品牌之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1950, Kroc discovered the first McDonald's restaurant in San Bernardino, California. He saw the unique business model and the potential for huge business opportunities, and decided to invest and help McDonald's expand nationally. This decision eventually led to McDonald's becoming one of the largest fast-food chains in the world.

points.title: 麦当劳特许经营体系的建立
points.titleEn: Establishment of the McDonald's Franchise System
points.description: 1955年，克洛克在伊利诺伊州德梅因建立了麦当劳的特许经营体系。这一体系使得麦当劳得以迅速扩张，并确保了品牌的一致性和质量。克洛克通过这一体系将麦当劳的理念和标准传播到世界各地。
points.descriptionEn: In 1955, Kroc established the McDonald's franchise system in Des Moines, Illinois. This system allowed for rapid expansion and ensured brand consistency and quality. Kroc used this system to spread the McDonald's philosophy and standards worldwide.

points.title: 麦当劳的全球化
points.description: 从1960年代开始，麦当劳开始在全球范围内扩张。克洛克推动了麦当劳的国际化战略，使其成为全球快餐文化的代表。这一时期，麦当劳在多个国家和地区开设了分店，进一步巩固了其作为全球快餐连锁品牌的地位。
points.descriptionEn: From the 1960s onwards, McDonald's began to expand globally. Kroc pushed for the internationalization strategy of McDonald's, making it a representative of global fast-food culture. During this period, McDonald's opened branches in multiple countries and regions, further consolidating its position as a global fast-food chain.

points.title: 麦当劳的持续发展
points.description: 在1970年代，克洛克继续推动麦当劳的发展和创新。他引入了新的菜单项目，如早餐和下午茶，并不断改进餐厅设计和顾客服务。这一时期的努力使得麦当劳成为美国乃至全球最受欢迎的快餐品牌之一。
points.descriptionEn: In the 1970s, Kroc continued to promote the development and innovation of McDonald's. He introduced new menu items such as breakfast and afternoon tea, and continuously improved the design of the restaurants and customer service. This period of efforts made McDonald's one of the most popular fast-food brands in the United States and around the world.

supporter.zh: 雷·克洛克被视为麦当劳的创始人之一，他的主要贡献在于将麦当劳从一个地方性快餐店发展成为全球性的快餐帝国。他的商业洞察力和执行力为麦当劳的成功奠定了基础。
supporter.en: Ray Kroc is seen as one of the founders of McDonald's, with his main contribution being the transformation of McDonald's from a local fast-food restaurant into a global fast-food empire. His business acumen and execution laid the foundation for McDonald's success.

critic.zh: 批评者认为克洛克过于强调利润和扩张，忽视了员工的福利和顾客的健康。他们指出，麦当劳的快餐文化对全球饮食文化产生了负面影响。
critic.en: Critics argue that Kroc placed too much emphasis on profit and expansion, neglecting employee welfare and customer health. They point out that McDonald's fast-food culture has had a negative impact on global dietary culture.

objective.zh: 客观来看，克洛克是20世纪最具影响力的商业领袖之一。他的商业策略和麦当劳的成功对全球快餐业产生了深远的影响。然而，他的商业实践也引发了对快餐文化和健康问题的广泛讨论。
objective.en: Objectively, Kroc is one of the most influential business leaders of the 20th century. His business strategies and the success of McDonald's have had a profound impact on the global fast-food industry. However, his business practices have also sparked widespread discussions about fast-food culture and health issues.

self.zh: “我总是相信，如果你有一个好的产品，你不需要去推销它，人们会自己来找你。”
self.en: "I always believed that if you have a good product, you don't need to sell it; people will come to you."

others.zh: “雷·克洛克是麦当劳的真正灵魂，没有他，麦当劳可能只是一个普通的快餐店。”
others.en: "Ray Kroc is the true soul of McDonald's; without him, McDonald's might have just been an ordinary fast-food restaurant."
